name: serious-stingray
description: A 6px-rounded outline CTA whose circular fill sweeps in from the far corner on hover.
purpose: Recreates a compact outlined action whose hover fill arrives as a circle from the opposite corner, without flattening the 6px radius through the shared Button atom.
bestFor: compact secondary actions that still need a clear hover fill
toolbar or card CTAs that should stay outlined at rest
pairs of outline actions next to a solid primary
avoidFor: full-width form submits that need a filled hit target at rest
icon-only controls that cannot use the 6em by 2.6em frame
